exposure: Intrathecal hyperbaric bupivacaine with buprenorphine 45 mug
Intrathecal hyperbaric bupivacaine with buprenorphine 60 mug
cohort: 90 ASA physical status Class II parturients undergoing elective caesarean section
finding: The addition of buprenorphine to intrathecal hyperbaric bupivacaine prolonged the duration of analgesia after caesarean section without producing major side effects for mothers or babies.
